title: The most generous player in sports history
description:
Wayne Gretzky's 1,963 career assists - the goals he set up for teammates - outnumber every other player's total career points. Second all-time is Jaromir Jagr, at 1,921.
Gretzky also owns the only four 200-point seasons ever played, held 61 NHL records at retirement, and no NHL player has worn his number 99 since - the league retired it forever.
